title: Theaflavin reduces Achilles tendon heterotopic ossification in mice through the TGF-beta/Smad signaling pathway.
authors: Li, Yuan; Li, Chenglong; Zhang, Wensheng; Le, Shiyong; Zhou, Jiongjiong; Luo, Bijun; Xie, Pusheng; Yan, Bo
one_liner_zh: 该文研究茶黄素通过TGF-beta/Smad通路抑制跟腱异位骨化，涉及分子对接但核心是蛋白-小分子互作，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: Heterotopic ossification (HO) affects millions of people worldwide. TGF-beta/Smad signaling pathway plays an essential role in HO of the Achilles tendon. Recent studies have found that Theaflavin can regulate the TGF-beta/Smad signaling pathway, suggesting Theaflavin may have a positive effect on HO. In this study, we aimed to study the effects of Theaflavin on preventing endochondral differentiation of Tendon-derived stem cells (TDSCs) and the HO process after in the achilles tendon injury model. Here, we investigated the role of Theaflavin in a mouse model of Achilles tendon heterotopic ossification. In addition, we use TDSCs to explore the molecular mechanism of Theaflavin affecting HO. Our data showed that Theaflavin can inhibit HO of the Achilles tendon and significantly reduce the volume of mature bone tissues. SOX9 and RUNX2 were decreased significantly after Theaflavin administration. Experiments showed Theaflavin inhibited TGF-beta/Smad signaling pathway during chondrogenic differentiation and osteogenic differentiation of TDSCs. Surface Plasmon Resonance Assay and Molecular docking simulation showed that a direct molecular interaction between Theaflavin and TbetaRI (a membrane receptor of TGF-betas). Meanwhile, Cellular Thermal Shift Assay showed Theaflavin bonded and thermally stabilized TbetaRI significantly. Moreover, WB and IHC displayed Theaflavin also exhibited inhibitory effects on TbetaRI phosphorylation. In summary, Our findings demonstrated that Theaflavin inhibited HO by down-regulating the TGF-beta/Smad signal pathway, and this effect may attributed to Theaflavin binded directly to TbetaRI and prevented its phosphorylation.
abstract_zh: 异位骨化（heterotopic ossification, HO）影响全球数百万人。TGF-beta/Smad信号通路在跟腱异位骨化中发挥重要作用。近期研究发现，茶黄素（Theaflavin）可调控TGF-beta/Smad信号通路，提示茶黄素可能对HO具有积极作用。在本研究中，我们旨在探讨茶黄素对肌腱源性干细胞（Tendon-derived stem cells, TDSCs）软骨内分化及跟腱损伤模型后HO过程的预防效果。此处，我们研究了茶黄素在小鼠跟腱异位骨化模型中的作用。此外，我们利用TDSCs探索茶黄素影响HO的分子机制。我们的数据显示，茶黄素可抑制跟腱HO，并显著减少成熟骨组织体积。茶黄素给药后，SOX9和RUNX2显著降低。实验表明，茶黄素在TDSCs的软骨分化及成骨分化过程中抑制了TGF-beta/Smad信号通路。表面等离子体共振实验（Surface Plasmon Resonance Assay）和分子对接模拟显示，茶黄素与TbetaRI（TGF-betas的膜受体）之间存在直接分子相互作用。同时，细胞热位移实验（Cellular Thermal Shift Assay）显示，茶黄素显著结合并使TbetaRI热稳定。此外，Western blot（WB）和免疫组化（IHC）显示，茶黄素对TbetaRI磷酸化也具有抑制作用。总之，我们的研究结果表明，茶黄素通过下调TGF-beta/Smad信号通路抑制HO，且该效应可能归因于茶黄素直接结合TbetaRI并阻止其磷酸化。
